text: If you make love with your partner in the morning, here are five things that happen to your body without you even knowing. And the last one is the best thing that could happen to you. First, you could live longer. Making love releases hormones that help the body reduce inflammation and protect the heart. Second, your immune system gets stronger. When two people connect with affection, the body responds by strengthening its defenses against bacteria and viruses. Third, you will sleep better at night. Making love stimulates the release of oxytocin and endorphins. These are natural substances that relax the mind and help the body find deeper sleep. Fourth, your heart works better. It increases the heart rate, improves circulation, and supports cardiovascular health. And fifth, stress melts away. When you make love, your brain releases oxytocin, dopamine, and endorphins. This calms the mind, improves your mood, and brings you back into balance. Making love in the morning is not just about pleasure. It is one of the most natural ways to take care of your body. But here is what most people miss. These benefits only happen fully when there is real connection, when there is presence, calm, trust. When two people come together without stress, without rushing, without carrying the weight of the day before. Most people are so disconnected from their own body that even in their most intimate moments, their mind is somewhere else. The hormones do not flow the same way. When your nervous system is in survival mode, you cannot truly connect with another person if you have not learned to connect with yourself first. Write in the comments. Balance. Balance. Balance. If this made sense to you, and if you want to learn how to calm your nervous system, to be truly present in your body, to release the stress that blocks everything, including your deepest connections, I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile. The link is in my profile.
